newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee eases as RBI buys dollars at 35.79/80.
newsitem.headline: India rupee eases as RBI buys dollars at 35.79/80.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) intervened in the foreign exchange market on Monday, buying dollars at 35.79/80 levels, dealers said.
"Yes, they are in the market, buying upto 35.80," said a dealer. In the absence of RBI intervention, the rupee had touched a high of 35.77 against the dollar on Monday.
The dollar was quoted at 35.795/805 rupees in latest deals.
The dollar opened at 35.78/79 on Monday.
